summary: Worked example migrating my-standalone-role.webapp (invalid dashed name, with a library module) into acme.webserver: init the collection, copy the role to roles/webapp, move manage_webserver.py to plugins/modules/manage.py, and update tasks to acme.webserver.manage.
questions: Can you walk me through migrating a real role with a custom module into a collection?
Should I rename my module when moving it into a collection?
How do I update tasks to use the moved module?

answer_card.title: Example: migrating a role with a module
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy collection init acme.webserver
mkdir acme/webserver/roles/webapp
cp my-standalone-role.webapp/* acme/webserver/roles/webapp/
cp my-standalone-role.webapp/library/manage_webserver.py acme/webserver/plugins/modules/manage.py
```
Then change `manage_webserver` to `acme.webserver.manage` in the role's tasks. Renaming is optional; the FQCN supplies the `webserver` context.
